content.short: CardanoPress is a plugin for WordPress that helps you easily create a Cardano powered website!
content.description: CardanoPress is revolutionizing the WordPress ecosystem by seamlessly integrating Cardano blockchain capabilities. The brainchild behind this innovation aimed to provide users a way to effortlessly incorporate Cardano DApps into their websites, eliminating complex coding barriers. Much like how Marlowe simplifies the creation of Cardano smart contracts through a visual interface, CardanoPress becomes the WordPress answer for easy Cardano integration.
content.meta: Find out about CardanoPress (WORDPRESS) on the Cardano Blockchain, so you can make well-informed investment decisions.
